text:
ITEM 1 | Crispy cooked strips, golden-brown to deep amber with darker well-browned edges, glossy and slightly oily sheen, flat ribbon-like pieces with rippled surface and layered fat/lean striations, roughly 2 cm wide and 15-20 cm long strips curled over the upper-right of the plate, covering about 15% of the plate area, approximately 2 cm thick at most, sitting on the white plate with no sauce | 45

ITEM 2 | Whole and halved strawberries, bright red with pale white-green cores visible on cut faces, glossy and moist surface, halves about 2-3 cm across, some whole berries about 2.5 cm, clustered in the lower-center of the plate beside blackberries, covering about 12% of the plate area, firm rounded shapes with juicy sheen | 60

ITEM 3 | Blackberries, dark purple-black drupelet clusters with matte-to-slightly-glossy surface, rounded shapes about 2 cm across, a few halved showing dark interior, scattered in a cluster along the lower-left of the fruit group, covering about 6% of the plate area, firm and bumpy texture | 30

ITEM 4 | Blueberries, small dark navy-blue spheres about 1 cm across with slight dusty bloom and smooth skin, scattered in a loose group across the center-right of the plate among the strawberries and blackberries, covering about 4% of the plate area, firm and round | 15
